📖 How to use

  1. Enter your starting principal and monthly contribution.
  2. Set the annual interest rate and the number of years.
  3. Choose the compounding frequency.
  4. Review the projected future value and the year-by-year growth table.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the compounding frequency and monthly contributions combined?

The annual rate is treated as a nominal rate compounding at the selected frequency (monthly, quarterly or annually), and monthly contributions are added every month using the equivalent monthly rate.

Does this account for inflation or taxes?

No. The projection is before inflation and taxes — real-world returns will be lower after both.

Is the interest earned each year the same?

No. Interest is compounding on a growing balance, so growth accelerates over time — the table shows this clearly in later years.
